definitions.explanation: The mark ◎, a circle inside a circle, used in Japan for "excellent" or "best choice": above ○ (good) in grading, surveys and product ratings, and for the favorite in horse-racing tips. Also said aloud as praise.

examples.japanese: {二重丸|にじゅうまる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける。
examples.english: To give it a double circle.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二重丸|にじゅうまる}だ。

⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二重丸|にじゅうまる}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{返|かえ}して→返す：09648_kaesu⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: My daughter was delighted when her teacher handed back her essay marked with a double circle.

notes:
⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧ (double) + ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (circle). Part of the Japanese marking system: ◎ excellent, ○ correct or good, △ partly right, × wrong.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二重丸|にじゅうまる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to mark with ◎
- {二重丸|にじゅうまる}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to get a double circle
- {二重丸|にじゅうまる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧: excellent work

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧: circle; correct (○)
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧: triangle; partly right (△)
- ばつ: X mark; wrong (×)
